question: Which mantra formula ending with namah is placed on the front of the head?
premises: A mantra names the Lord of all beings.
It is placed on the front of the head.
inference: The formula 'Īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ' ending with namah is placed on the front of the head.
plain_english: Place 'Īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ' ending with namah on the front of the head.
